setup.command: cd backend && (uv venv .venv && uv pip install -q -p .venv/bin/python -r requirements.txt) || (python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt)

check.command: cd backend && export SECRET_KEY=ci-test-secret-key-not-for-production DATABASE_URL=postgresql://test:test@localhost:5432/test && for f in tests/test_*_suite.py; do echo "== $f =="; .venv/bin/python "$f" > /dev/null || exit 1; done
